text:
Sam (product): Quick sync — we need guidance on shaping onboarding usage for enterprise deals. AEs are asking for generous trial credits + soft caps. What constraints do we want vs revenue risk?

Priya (sales): Customer A asked for 2M tokens/month for 90 days, wants soft cap (alerts) not hard quota. They say conversion likely if performance stable.

Mika (customer success): We can offer time-limited credits but need expiry, clear alerting, and success metrics (activation -> paid). Otherwise CS gets stuck.

Diego (finance): 2M tokens x our unit cost is material. We should avoid unlimited free tail. Prefer: limited onboarding credits + required min commit or defined overage pricing. Need modeling.

Anika (eng): Implementable options: per-tenant monthly quota with configurable "soft" threshold that emits alerts, and an optional hard throttle. Engineering cost: dynamic per-account config + console UI + billing hook. Existing rate-limit infra helps.

Hannah (legal): Credits that never expire create liability/accounting headaches. Also need abuse protections and a clause that reserves our right to suspend if misuse detected.

Priya (sales): We need the ability to set higher trial caps per-deal (enterprise flexibility). Manual workaround is painful. A Console toggle would be ideal.

Sam (product): Proposal: create an "Onboarding Credit" add-on feature: time-limited token allotment, configurable per-deal, expires, emits soft-threshold alerts to CS/sales, and falls back to overage billing or prompts commit. Launch gates: console UI + billing integration + telemetry for conversion + legal-approved T&Cs.

Anika (eng): Example config we could add to per-tenant flags:
```
onboarding_credit:
  amount: 2000000
  expires_at: 2026-06-01
  soft_threshold_pct: 80
  hard_limit: false
```
This would let us ship core infra quickly. Console and billing links next.

Mika (customer success): Need automated emails to CS and AE at 70% and 90% thresholds, and a quick action in Console to extend or convert credits.

Diego (finance): Also recommend contract language: if onboarding credits > X tokens, require a minimum committed volume or apply an overage multiplier (e.g., committed unit price * 1.25). That prevents giving big free trials with zero revenue capture.

Hannah (legal): I'll draft a short clause for the SOW and the T&Cs: expiry of credits, right to suspend for abuse, and explicit conversion trigger language. Also will check accounting impact.

Priya (sales): What's the eng ETA and risk for Q launch? Sales needs this for 3 pending deals.

Anika (eng): Rough estimate: backend flags + billing hook = 3 sprints; Console UI = 1 sprint; email alerts + ops runbook = 1 sprint. If we prioritize, we can pilot in 2 sprints by reusing existing rate-limit infra.

Sam (product): Action items: 1) Anika create backlog ticket + spike for billing integration. 2) Diego finalize pricing floor/overage rule by EOD Fri. 3) Hannah draft clause by Mon. 4) Priya pick 2–3 pilot customers. 5) Mika define success metrics (conversion rate, time-to-paid).

Diego (finance): I'll model a floor and share numbers. If pilots convert > 15% we greenlight broader launch.

Mika (customer success): I'll prepare onboarding playbook and KPIs.

Priya (sales): I'll nominate 3 pilots and prep deal notes.

Hannah (legal): Will post draft clause into this thread when ready.

Sam (product): Sounds good. Pilot-only feature flag + minimal UI is the path. Thanks everyone. :+1:

Anika (eng): note: we'll need DB schema for per-tenant credit state, will add to ticket.

Priya (sales): Awesome — appreciate the quick alignment.

Mika (customer success): On it.

Hannah (legal): Draft incoming Monday.

Sam (product): Closing thread — will follow up on workspace.
